headline: Md Boktiar Mahbub Murad climbs from 92nd to 60th on ARC-2

sections.text: Md Boktiar Mahbub Murad gained 8.47 points to reach 45.00, moving from 92nd to 60th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board in the past day.
The entry is listed under the competitor's own name. Standings remain provisional, and medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
